correctness.rationale: Odd-order rotation subgroup V is characteristic, hence each automorphism is uniquely determined by L∈GL_d(F_p), b∈V. Actual twisted-conjugation translations act by im(I-L) in rotations and im(I+L) in reflections. The remaining reflection generator induces affine inversion on each odd-order quotient, with exactly one fixed point; all others pair. Translation-orbit fibers have p^(d-a/c) elements, yielding the entire class-size distribution and R formula. The eigenspaces at ±1 intersect trivially. To realize all a+c<=d, choose 1/-1 diagonal blocks and an irreducible companion block of residual dimension>=2, a non-±1 scalar for residual dimension one when p>=5, or an inflated Jordan block when p=3,d>=2 and a+c>=1. Base-p sum uniqueness for p>=3 gives the cardinality formula. Independently constructed all GL2(F3) matrices, all twisted-generator actions on G, observed R∈{2,3,4,6} with multiplicities 18,16,12,2; this corroborates rather than proves universal d.

final_claim: For all odd primes p, d>=2, and automorphisms (L,b) of F_p^d⋊C2, the two cosets have one twisted class of size p^(d-a) or p^(d-c) and (p^a-1)/2 or (p^c-1)/2 classes of twice that size, where a=dim ker(I-L), c=dim ker(I+L). Every a+c<=d occurs; R=1+(p^a+p^c)/2 and the spectrum contains exactly floor((d+2)^2/4) values.
limitations: Odd prime characteristic and d>=2 only; d=1,p=3 is a genuine nonattainment boundary. Not spectrum for arbitrary odd abelian kernels or characteristic two; finite computation does not prove all p,d.
